sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast,
we speak slowly. We use easy English. We repeat important words. Today, we travel to
Europe. We go to Poland. Our city today is Rotswauf. Rotswau is colorful. Rotswau is
historic. Rotswauf is full of life. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's start
our journey. Part 2. Poland in Europe. Poland is a country in Europe. It is in
Central Europe. Poland has cities, villages, and nature. It has forests and
rivers. It has a long history. Many things changed in Poland. The country is
modern today, but history is still important. Rotswauf is one of the most
beautiful cities in Poland. It is not the capital, but it is very special. Part 3.
Where is Rotswauf? Rotswauf is in the west of Poland. It is near the border with
other countries. The city is built on a river. The river is called the Oder River.
There are many small islands. There are many bridges. Water is part of the city.
Because of this, Rotswauf looks unique. It feels open and fresh. Part 4. Weather and
seasons. Rotswau has four seasons. In spring, flowers grow. In summer, days are
warm. In autumn, leaves are yellow and brown. In winter, it can be cold. People
wear warm clothes in winter. They enjoy parks in summer. The weather changes.
Life changes with the seasons. Hash hat. Part 5. A city with a long history.
Rotswauf is a very old city. People lived here many years ago. The city changed names and
rulers. Different cultures lived here. You can see this history and buildings. You can
feel it in the streets. Old and new lived together. The past is still present.
Part 6. Old Town and Market Square. The heart of Rotswauf is the old town. The
main place is the Market Square. The square is very large. It is colorful and
lively. There are old houses. There are cafes and shops. People meet here every
day. Tourists take photos. Life feels happy here. Part 7. The Town Hall. In the
Market Square, there is a Town Hall. It is very old and beautiful. The building has
details and decorations. It shows the city's history. People stop and look at it. It is
one of the symbols of Rotswauf. The building tells many stories. Part 8. Bridges and islands.
Rotswauf is called the city of bridges. There are more than 100 bridges. The river goes
through the city. Small islands are everywhere. People walk over bridges. They
enjoy the water views. The city feels calm and romantic. Water brings peace. Part 9. The
Rotswauf's. Rotswauf has something fun. It has small dwarf statues. There are many
corners. People look for them. Children love them. Each dwarf is different. They make the
city playful and friendly. Part 10. Food and daily life. Food and Rotswauf is traditional.
People eat soup, meat and potatoes. A popular food is pierogi. Pierogi are small dumplings.
They can be sweet or salty. People like to eat together. Food brings people close. Daily life
is active but not too fast. People work, study and relax. Part 11. Students in modern city.
Rotswauf is a student city. Many young people live here. There are universities and schools.
There are libraries and cafes. Students bring energy. The city feels young and modern.
Old buildings and young people mix well. This makes Rotswauf special. Part 12. Nature,
Feeling and Good Parks. People walk up and relax there. Nature is part of city life. Water,
trees and sky are close. Rotswauf is a city of history, bridges, dwarfs and young life.
